out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Lighting Intensity, 20 Foot Candles Minimum
violations.observation: Observed that inadequate lighting was provided in the consumer self-service areas, reach-in refrigerators, handwashing areas, warewashing areas, equipment and storage areas, and/or toilet rooms. The electrical power is out in the restroom.
violations.corrective_action: Increase the lighting to provide a minimum of 20 foot candles in these areas. Reinstall the power in the restrooms, for customers and employees to have access to them.
